headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.5.27-modder.48
summary: Friend requests can be sent again, and friend rows show avatars plus an option to view a player's Xbox profile or remove them.

items.text: Send friend requests again — Xbox rejects PUT requests without a body.
Show each friend's gamer picture in the friends list, requests and search results.
Open a menu on any friend to view their Xbox profile or remove them.
